Awesome!
Feb 2020 • Couples
Without a doubt, one of the best meals we've had in Vietnam. The cooks understand how to balance western flavours, which at the price point is astounding considering other that try the same for much more (and often fail). 

The only very slight disappointment was the seared sesame tuna, which was a little overcooked to our taste and we found the sesame coating a little thick, which dried out the fish. 
Everything else was fantastic. The pizza was the best we've had in three years and the baked oysters blew our minds. 
The cocktails were well mixed and reasonably priced. If you like your drinks strong, order the Long Island as I did. If you like them tasty and not too sweet, go for the strawberry daiquiri, as the Mrs did. 

We finished the night off with shisha and followed their recommendation. Very happy we did as it was smooth and delicious! If you're reading this looking for something that isn't one of the obviously crap fine dining recommendations for nha trang you can stop searching - this is the spot!
